risks.risk: A volume may be missing or have damaged pages inside.
risks.proof: A flip-through video of every book showing all pages and bindings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly incomplete or internally damaged.

risks.risk: Pages, bindings, or covers may be worse than the visible exterior suggests.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of spines, page edges, and open bindings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn second-hand with unknown internal condition.

risks.risk: Water stains, mold, smoke smell, or highlighting may be present.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of page edges, inside covers, and text pages, plus a description or video for smell.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially stained, moldy, smoky, or highlighted.

risks.risk: Edition, publication year, or ISBN may be outdated or undesirable.
risks.proof: Photos of copyright and title pages for each book.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown edition or year.

risks.risk: The books may not be sold as a single lot of ten.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full stack together or seller confirmation of lot size.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an uncertain quantity rather than a confirmed ten-book lot.

proof_requests: Flip-through video of all books showing every page.
Close-up photos of spines, page edges, and inside covers.
Photos of copyright and title pages for edition and year.
Confirmation that all ten books are sold together as one lot.
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a stack of second-hand self-help and business books, so a worst-case price is possible despite unverified condition and bundle claims.
